boundaries: Defender type is the current opposing Active Pokemon type, not attacking Pokemon type, attack damage type, attached Energy or a covered Basic.
Type and family filters are conjunctive; entries within each list are alternatives. GX and EX_LEGACY remain distinct from modern EX and V.
Tool host conditions are separate from defender filters. Disabled Tool or Ability effects contribute no bonus.
Active-only bonuses do not increase Bench damage, counters or attacks with zero base damage. Attacker bonuses survive defender-effect bypass and apply before Weakness.
This-turn bonuses belong to the player, expire at turn end, stack and apply to matching later entrants.
Family-filtered spread evaluates every individual opponent Pokemon and preserves the exact printed Weakness/Resistance scope.
Black Ray GX draft is test-only; no incomplete whole card is marked supported. No previous supported programs or metadata changes. Artwork excluded.
